cues.text: Why don't you just admit that you're freaked out by my robot hand?
I'm not freaked out by- it's...
I'm freaked out! I have nightmares that I'm being chased...
...by these giant robotic claws of death...

events.title: Thom Confesses Fear of Robot Hand

events.why: This revelation about Thom’s fear is a key character detail that could affect his decisions later.
